subject: Observability handoff & runbook sync — dashboards, traces, alerts
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Trent Murray <trent@cloudedtech.com>, Elena Varga <elena@cloudedtech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Dec 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability handoff & runbook sync — dashboards, traces, alerts

Hi Trent / Elena —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Per our discussion, Im sharing a first-pass runbook and a proposed scope for the observability handoff so your SREs can get telemetry flowing before go-live. Attached: redwood-observability-runbook-v1.pdf (draft), a set of dashboard templates (dashboard-templates.json), and a tracing-hook checklist (tracing-hook-checklist.xlsx).

High-level scope we need to confirm:
- Dashboards: latency (p50/p95/p99) by model & route, token usage/cost, error rates (5xx/4xx/application), and KV cache hit ratios.
- Tracing hooks: entry/exit spans for request lifecycle, model inference spans (warm/cold), and correlation IDs between API gateway and runtime.
- Error taxonomy & runbooks: map observed errors to triage steps, owners, and automatic fallbacks.
- Alert routing: severity matrix (P0/P1/P2), paging rules, and escalation contacts by region.

Proposed timeline (high level):
1) This week: review runbook + confirm telemetry endpoints (your team)
2) Next week: instrument tracing hooks + push dashboard templates to your Grafana
3) Week after: tabletop run of alert routing and a quick incident simulation

Action items for today:
- Trent: confirm desired retention window for request logs (we default to 30d) and whether SOC2 log-forwarding is required.
- Elena: share the names + slack handles of the two SREs who will be primary owners.
- Internal (ccd): Marissa, Ben, Laura, can you review the attached runbook and call out any missing Redwoods-side steps?

Ill schedule a 45-min handoff session for Thursday to walk through the runbook and assign owners. Calendar invite coming.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-observability-runbook-v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB), dashboard-templates.json (3 KB), tracing-hook-checklist.xlsx (25 KB)

From: Trent Murray <trent@cloudedtech.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Varga <elena@cloudedtech.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Dec 2029 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Observability handoff & runbook sync — dashboards, traces, alerts

Jordan, thanks for the clear plan and the documents. Quick answers and a couple of asks: 

- Retention: we need 90 days for request logs for our compliance team (SOC2 + internal audit). Can you confirm any cost delta?
- SOC2 forwarding: yes, well want an option to forward audit-relevant logs to our SIEM (Splunk). Is there an existing connector or will we need to ship logs to an S3 bucket?
- Dashboards: critical ones for us are per-model tail-latency, per-route token-cost, and a consumer-facing error-rate panel (so product can see user impact).

Also: copying our SREs: Elena will be primary. Elena, meet Marissa / Ben / Laura from Redwood. 

On the runbook I skimmed: can you add a short section that describes the automated fallback behavior (which model variant is used, and how we surface model-degraded warnings)? Thats been a showstopper in past integrations.

Happy to join the Thursday meeting.

Best,
Trent
Director of Platform Engineering | CloudedTech
trent@cloudedtech.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Trent Murray <trent@cloudedtech.com>, Elena Varga <elena@cloudedtech.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Dec 2029 10:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability handoff & runbook sync — dashboards, traces, alerts

Thanks Jordan and Trent —

I reviewed the draft runbook quickly. High level notes / proposed owners:
- Dashboard templates: Ben to own adapting the Grafana panels for CloudedTechs metrics and shipping a JSON import. Ben, estimate time? (Id budget one full day to tune top-level panels.)
- Tracing hooks: Laura to provide the instrumentation checklist and a short code snippet for our SDK to ensure consistent correlation IDs. Laura, Ill need the checklist by EOD Wednesday to keep the timeline.
- Error taxonomy & runbooks: Ill take point on mapping Redwood error codes to CloudedTech incident severities; well need one joint workshop to agree on mappings.
- Alert routing & escalation: propose P0 = paging to on-call + exec notif; P1 = page on-call only; P2 = ticket to SRE queue.

On retention & SOC2 forwarding (Trents asks): 
- We support 90d retention; theres a nominal storage uplift cost (we can supply an estimate after Ben pulls the token/requests histo).
- For SIEM forwarding we can either push events to an S3 bucket (recommended) or set up a Splunk HEC endpoint. Ill coordinate with our infra team for the latter if you prefer direct ingestion.

Action items: 
- Ben: produce Grafana JSON samples and cost delta estimate by EOD Wednesday.
- Laura: deliver tracing-hook-checklist.xlsx final version by 2029-12-04 10:00 PT.
- Jordan & Trent: confirm 90d retention and preferred SIEM method in the Thursday call.

Marissa Cole
Senior CS Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Thanks all, quick summary and next steps:

1) Retention & SIEM: Trent, well default to 90d retention and set up an S3-forwarding pipeline for your SIEM. Ben will provide the storage uplift estimate.
2) Runbook: Ive added a short section describing automated fallback behavior and how we label model-degraded warnings (see v1.1 notes in the Drive link).
3) Owners & deadlines: Ben (dashboards & cost estimate) by 2029-12-04 EOD; Laura (tracing checklist) by 2029-12-04 10:00 PT; Marissa (taxonomy) will run the mapping workshop next Tuesday.

I created the calendar event for the handoff: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=obs-handoff-sync-20291204 — please accept if you can. If anyone cant make it, tell me and well split the session into two focused calls.

Thanks everyone; Jordan signing off until the meeting.

Jordan Blake
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com
